purpose: Use Spain-mandated theoretical and recent actual ex-jackpot RTP disclosures as current cross-operator fingerprints without promoting cross-operator equivalence to an execution fact.

regulatoryBasis.rule: Spanish machine-game rules require expected mathematical return plus actual prize-return percentages for each of the preceding six months, excluding jackpot prizes, and disclosure of the participation percentage allocated to the jackpot.

examples.game: Eye of Horus Megaways Jackpot King
King Kong Cash Go Bananas JPK

daznBetSpain.helpStatement: DAZN BET says expected RTP is in each game's information and links a platform RTP page with recent game results; the current public shell is JavaScript-rendered and needs a dedicated extraction pass.

interpretation.strong: Two current Blueprint Jackpot King titles have an exact theoretical RTP match between bet365 Spain and Botemania Spain, showing that operator-to-operator equality can occur for a title/configuration.
interpretation.guard: Other Blueprint Jackpot King titles differ across operators, so title identity alone is not enough to import a base RTP, contribution, reserve or hazard configuration.
interpretation.use: Treat exact theoretical-RTP matches as a configuration fingerprint clue only. Execution still requires the Botemania/DAZN BET rules and live-state identity for the exact Spanish operator being played.
